I believe that when we are learning a language, we aren't actually just learning the language. We are learning cultural elements, traditions, at times even a completely new way of thinking. 

During our lessons, I'll be sure to guide you through the neverending maze of Hungarian culture as well, introducing colloquialisms and useful phrases which we actually use during our everyday life. 

I think it's important to always encourage, as this can increase our motivation to continue learning even when we don't feel like we are making progress. 

I'm here to help you!

For people who are more advanced, I will offer conversational lessons, making a PowerPoint presentation revolving around a certain topic and holding a conversation with you about it.

During the lesson, I might spontaneously show you memes and songs depending on the context of what we are learning.

pro_course_detail.title: The Flow of English -Reading Pleasures- Can you imagine yourself speaking like a native?
pro_course_detail.description:
What if you knew there was one simple exercise that could totally transform the way you speak English language? 
1. Reading out loud increases your opportunity for retention. This activity forces you to not only use your brain and your eyes but your ears and voice as well. You’re not only thinking about the language and seeing it, but you’re also hearing it and saying it. There is possibly no better way to immerse yourself in the English language. While you’re reading you’re actually subconsciously soaking up the thinking and speech patterns of the language. 
2. You’re exercising your facial muscles. It’s more important than you think! At first, it may seem you’re totally incapable of pronouncing certain sounds. Many individuals whose first language is Spanish have a difficulty enunciating the letter “z” in English. Spanish doesn’t contain that sound. But native English speakers sometimes have a hard time with the “rr” sound of Spanish. This is not a natural sound for them to use. In each case, it’s necessary to develop the specific muscles for proper pronunciation. 
3. You’ll learn how to become responsible for correcting yourself. Don’t be surprised that as you read out loud, you’ll slowly begin to “police" yourself. You’ll discover yourself stopping and pronouncing the word again properly. That’s exactly one of the goals of this exercise. 
Choose a novel you’ve always wanted to read or one of your favorite authors. If you’re a sports fan, for example, then you could read an autobiography of your favorite athlete.

pro_course_detail.title: CROATIAN: Step 1 - a good place to start

These lessons are designed to make learning Croatian simple, strategic, and, most importantly, rewarding.  The goal here is to lay a strong foundation. One of the biggest challenges? The declension system and cases. But don’t stress! I’ve created a step-by-step, student-friendly approach that breaks them down in a clear and practical way, with lots of examples to help you use them naturally in conversation.

But grammar isn’t everything! From day one, you’ll also work on speaking, listening, reading, and writing in a balanced well-rounded way. 

Plus, you’ll learn how to study smarter—not harder. Each lesson will give you simple tools to practice effectively and build a routine that works for you. If you want to go even deeper into efficient study strategies, I highly recommend checking out the "Language Learning Strategies" course for more personalized techniques.


WHAT WE'LL FOCUS ON:

✅ Understanding and using the declension system
✅ Present and past tense basics
✅ Expanding your vocabulary
✅ Learning the basics of how to study effectively and independently
✅ Practicing Croatian with intention 
✅ Setting achievable short-term goals to use as milestones

These lessons are all about learning how to learn any language. We break languages down into simple building blocks and focus on key skills—speaking, listening, reading, writing, and vocabulary.

Many people think they’ll improve just by taking lessons, but how you learn matters. For example, speaking—do you just show up to class? There’s a smarter way! If you feel stuck or frustrated, it might be because something in your approach isn’t working. We’ll figure out what’s slowing you down and fix it together!

I use fun, interactive exercises to help you understand languages naturally. No boring memorization—just smart strategies to make learning easier and more fun. Whether you’re learning Croatian, English, or another language, you’ll gain confidence and learn with curiosity and clarity.


WHAT YOU'LL LEARN:

✅ The basics of languages
✅ How to break down and understand any language
✅ How to improve speaking, reading, listening, and writing
✅ How to grow your vocabulary
✅ How to create your own learning materials
✅ How to set clear goals and achieve them
